name: Eugene 3x3 Mania 2017

venue.name: [Sheldon Community Center](https://www.eugene-or.gov/Facilities/Facility/Details/Sheldon-Community-Center-20)
venue.details: First door on your left when you walk in the building

information: The registration fee is $14, plus $2 for Fewest Moves and Multiple Blindfolded. There is an 80 competitor limit, so please register soon if you plan on attending. Note that parking lot has limited space, so consider carpooling or local transit to make your commute easier.
